logistics.format: CyberLive performance-based, web-based proctored (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GCFA でホストフォレンジック深度を持ったうえで、エンタープライズスケールの脅威ハンティング/IR を扱う GEIR (FOR608) に進むのが SANS DFIR ラダー。

plus.note: 大規模脅威ハンティングを End-to-End で評価する数少ない上位認証。

minus.note: 2024 年公開で求人要件としての浸透はこれから。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Enterprise-scale, end-to-end threat hunting assessed through CyberLive supports expert incident-response responsibility at five years; recent introduction and limited hiring uptake weaken market recognition, not the recorded advanced task scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: CyberLive assessment of enterprise-scale, end-to-end hunting and response supports expert operational depth at the five-year profile. Limited uptake reduces recruiting familiarity, so the strong practical signal matters more than name recognition or cost.

alex-novak.rationale: CyberLive tasks and recorded end-to-end enterprise hunting provide strong evidence of professional response delivery. The five-year profile and recent limited uptake do not yet establish the broader senior recognition required for expert placement.
